title: Latency and timeouts on storage-svc

detection.alert: storage-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on storage-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] storage-svc 2026-07-13 11:46-16:36: storage-svc: 276 of 380 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-13 11:46 and 2026-07-13 16:36 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Config change to {key} in {svc} broke calls under load.

culprit.diff:
@@ -104,3 +104,3 @@ retry.max
 retry:
-  max_attempts: 3
+  max_attempts: 15
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change to retry.max in storage-svc broke calls under load.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `outbound call failed after <*> attempts`.
